title: Content search engine design
description: Why this uses ripgrep libraries instead of shelling out.
body: Built from the same crates ripgrep is built from (ignore, grep-regex, grep-searcher) rather than shelling out to rg. Deliberate: git is on every developer's machine for its own reasons, rg is not, and this cannot depend on a tool nobody chose. Using ignore buys .gitignore support for free — the same walker VS Code uses — which lets this retire hardcoded skip lists entirely.
